_source: README Expected outcomes — E2E-15. Asserts a Mermaid block is emitted and fenced. Whether it RENDERS is a GitHub-side property no API exposes, so that stays manual. Deliberately does NOT assert the absence of `<` / `>`: the sanitizer emits entity-encoded labels on purpose (observed in live output: `A["src/handler.ts<br/>deleteSession()"]`) and Mermaid decodes them at render time — asserting their absence would fail on correct output.
